items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Professor Minetta talked about he used to play a few more years ago... I thought your uncle would be about that age. No, he's not that old. He's younger.

ctx.x: No, he was about 61 or 62. That's all I know.

I know Professor Minetta talked about he used to play a few more years ago. Back in the old days in the district and all. That's right. The past is about 72 now. Yes. Or will be 72. I thought your uncle would be about that age. No, he's not that old. He's younger. I knew that he played drums. So we'll talk to him and get his story directly. Is that somebody at your door? Yes. If you want to stop any time, we can just turn this off. It doesn't have to be any special order or not. No. Did your father play any…
No, my father didn't play anything.
